entries.detail: The November 2026 sweep is complete: the six products that could not be verified in the first pass (Monday.com, Shopify, Zoho CRM, Setmore, Microsoft 365, Klaviyo) were verified later on 2026-11-15 against vendor sources, closing full coverage at 49 of 49 products. The full sweep date advances to 2026-11-15.

US list prices verified against the structured pricing data published on monday.com/pricing in USD: Free $0, Basic $9 per seat per month billed annually ($12 billed monthly), Standard $12 ($14 monthly), Pro $19 ($24 monthly), Enterprise custom. No change.

Full US ladder verified on shopify.com/pricing: Starter $5, Basic $39 per month ($29 billed annually), Grow $105 ($79 annually), Advanced $399 ($299 annually), Plus from $2,300. The $1/month for 3 months new merchant offer is live on the page. No change.

US list prices verified against Zoho's own published price file for its CRM pricing page: Standard $14, Professional $23, Enterprise $40, Ultimate $52 per user per month billed annually; monthly billing is $20, $35, $50 and $65. Prices unchanged; the billing basis is now stated wherever the tiers appear.

Setmore's current published lineup is two plans, Free $0 (up to 4 users) and Pro $5 per user per month billed annually ($12 billed monthly), per Setmore's own published pricing information. The recorded Team tier no longer exists: it appeared on Setmore's pricing page in January 2025 (unlimited users, $5 billed annually, $9 billed monthly) and was gone by November 2025. Team tier removed.

Microsoft's public Canadian pricing pages (the plan comparison page and the plan chooser, checked 2026-11-15) now publish only Business Basic C$9.50 and the Copilot bundles, Business Standard with Copilot C$31.90 and Business Premium with Copilot C$43.40 per user per month paid yearly. The without-Copilot Standard and Premium prices recorded in October are no longer published there. Lineup corrected to the published tiers.

Free $0 (250 profiles) and Email $20 per month at 500 profiles re-verified on klaviyo.com/pricing. The recorded SMS figure (Canada $18 per 1,000 sends) belonged to the credit system Klaviyo retired on July 13, 2026; per Klaviyo's help centre, mobile messages are now billed per message in dollars, with rates by country and number type shown in the app. SMS tier corrected to the per-message model; Klaviyo no longer publishes a per-1,000 figure.

Monthly sweep of all 49 tracked products against vendor pricing pages. 43 products verified and re-dated to 2026-11-15; six could not be verified this pass and keep their previous dates (Monday.com, Shopify, Zoho CRM, Setmore, Microsoft 365, Klaviyo). Coverage was not complete, so this pass is not a full sweep and the full sweep date stays 2026-09-30.
US list prices corrected from the vendor's pricing page: Basic $16 to $19 per month billed annually ($25 billed monthly), Core $23 to $29, Plus $39 to $49. Advanced $99 billed annually unchanged.

The Unlimited tier is renamed Core and corrected $7 to $9 per user per month billed yearly ($12 billed monthly). Business corrected $12 to $17 billed yearly ($25 billed monthly). Free Forever $0 unchanged.
Tiers renamed: Emerging to Starter, Growing to Standard, Powerhouse to Premium. Starter $20 and Standard $34 per month unchanged; Premium corrected $61 to $69 per month ($49 to $55 billed annually).

Billing basis corrected: recorded $16 (Teams) and $37 (Organizations) are the monthly billing rates. Annual billing: Teams $12, Organizations $28 per user per month; pages now lead with the annual figures.
Annual prices unchanged ($18, $36, $54, $72). Monthly billing figures corrected from the vendor's pricing FAQ: Starter $21 to $22, Growth $38 to $40. Advanced $60 and Ultimate $75 monthly unchanged.
SEO entry price corrected $139 to $139.95 per month (about $117.33 billed annually, unchanged). Starter $199 and Pro+ $299 confirmed.

US list prices confirmed on the rendered US pricing page: Simple $10, Early $27, Growing $59, Established $97 per month; 80% off the first 3 months for new customers. No change from the 2026-11-13 correction.
Not verified this pass: the vendor's pricing page serves Canadian-dollar pricing with no US-dollar view; recorded US list prices could not be read on a vendor page. Verification date not advanced.

Partly verified: Basic US$39 per month (US$29 billed annually) and the $1 per month for 3 months offer confirmed on vendor pages; the full US plan ladder could not be displayed (Canadian-dollar regional pricing served). Verification date not advanced.
Not verified this pass: Zoho's pricing page serves Canadian-dollar pricing only from this region; recorded US list prices could not be read on a vendor page. Verification date not advanced.

Partly verified: Free $0 and Pro $5 per user per month billed annually confirmed; the recorded Team tier no longer appears on the vendor's pricing page, so the ladder was not verified as a whole and no change was made. Verification date not advanced.

Partly verified: Business Basic C$9.50 confirmed; the recorded without-Copilot prices for Business Standard and Premium are no longer published on Microsoft's public pricing pages, so the ladder was not verified as a whole and no change was made. Verification date not advanced.

Partly verified: Free $0 and Email $20 per month at 500 profiles confirmed; the recorded SMS add-on figure (Canada $18 per 1,000 sends) could not be confirmed after Klaviyo's move to per-message billing, and published sources disagree on the Canadian rate. No change made. Verification date not advanced.

Correction: the 2026-10-25 entries for QuickBooks Online recorded a plan name and list price that do not exist in QuickBooks Online Canada (Lite C$2/mo, list C$20). The offer confirmed on the vendor's site is 90% off for 6 months for new subscribers (EasyStart C$3/mo, list C$30). The original entries stay in this log; this entry corrects them.

US list prices re-verified against the vendor's own pricing page and corrected: Early $25 to $27, Growing $55 to $59, Established $90 to $97. A new entry tier, Simple at $10 per month, now sits below Early; starting prices and page dates updated.

US list prices re-verified against Canva's own published pricing and corrected: Pro $15 to $18 per month and $120 to $144 per year; Canva Teams ($10 per person, 3-person minimum) is discontinued for new sign-ups and replaced by Canva Business at $25 per person per month or $250 per person per year, no seat minimum. The old 3-person crossover math was removed.

The previous headline offer ($1/month for your first year, Solopreneur) is no longer offered. Replaced with the current offer found on freshbooks.com/en-ca/pricing: 80% off for 4 months.

Previous headline specifics (C$3/month on EasyStart for 6 months) could not be confirmed. Corrected to the offer confirmed on quickbooks.intuit.com/ca today: 90% off for new subscribers (Lite C$2/mo, list C$20).
